The weather was sunny that day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school gate by bike. Amy is interested in drawing. Best of all, take notes while you listen.
David is reading a book about math. David learned a lot about math. David drinks water after doing sports. Also, the teacher wrote the answer on the blackboard.

Last Saturday, David and Amy went to the school gate. There are always many people at the classroom. They took many photos at the classroom. What's more, the clown's antics made the whole audience laugh.
Amy's birthday is in January. Life is full of small surprises. Both of them like chicken and water.
